english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a baked cookie in Hong Kong.
Use this specifically for sweet Western-style cookies, especially when distinguishing them from crackers.

examples.jyutping: ni1 faai3 kuk1 kei4 hou2 hoeng1

examples.english: This biscuit is sweet and smells great.
examples.jyutping: ni1 faai3 kuk1 kei4 tim4 tim4 dei2 hou2 hoeng1
